artifact: For the run date 2031-04-12: if review result is changes_requested, select return_for_edits; otherwise, if release date is on or before 2031-04-12, select post; otherwise select wait. Keep all notice records unchanged.
explanation: The only necessary change is to check the release date before posting an approved notice. Posting is allowed on the release date or later. Notices with changes_requested return for editing regardless of date. The existing record fields are sufficient.
